title: RiboMetric: A comprehensive quality assessment tool for ribosome profiling datasets
description: RiboMetric is a Python command-line tool for quality assessment of ribosome profiling (Ribo-Seq) datasets. It calculates comprehensive QC metrics covering read-length distribution, 3-nucleotide periodicity, terminal nucleotide bias, metagene uniformity, CDS coverage, and regional read distribution, and produces interactive HTML reports, tabular outputs, and pipeline-ready QC gates.
